title: Coverage module with mock PAS adapter and automatic verification
acceptance: src/modules/coverage/ exports service(ctx) with getPolicySnapshot, searchPolicies, verifyCoverage, getLatestVerification, seedPolicies; routes match the openapi coverage and /policies paths
seedPolicies(policies[]) returns { inserted } and stores per-tenant rows in coverage_policies; modules.md coverage section documents it and states contract version 1.1.0

verifyCoverage returns status in_force|lapsed|not_found|excluded|needs_review with reasons[], deductible and limits, and publishes claim.coverage.verified (payload has no PII); results are persisted in coverage_verifications

Rules covered by tests: loss date in/out of term, LOB mismatch, vehicle or property not on policy, collision, comprehensive incl. glass, liability, dwelling, personal property, water damage exclusion (e.g. flood/seepage), missing policy -> not_found, ambiguous -> needs_review
Subscribing to claim.reported triggers verifyCoverage once (idempotent on event id)
searchPolicies finds by lastName, postalCode, vin, phone via ctx.crypto.hmacIndex blind indexes; PII fields are not stored in plaintext index columns
Tenant isolation test: tenant A policies invisible to tenant B
brief: Build src/modules/coverage/ (index.mjs exporting service(ctx), routes.mjs, port.mjs, adapters/mock-pas.mjs, verify.mjs, migrations/schema). Read architecture/core-runtime-api.md for ctx (db, bus, crypto, tenants, clock, modules, route registration, tenant-bound ctx). Policy port: define an adapter interface { id, getPolicy({policyNumber, asOf}), search(criteria) } selected by TenantConfig.integrations.policyPort (default 'mock-pas'); only mock-pas is built in. mock-pas stores synthetic PolicySnapshot docs per tenant in coverage_policies (tenant_id, policy_number, doc, plus blind-index columns last_name_idx, postal_idx, vin_idx, phone_idx from ctx.crypto.hmacIndex). Note modules.md names mock_policies; the ADDED table name is coverage_policies - update modules.md accordingly (contract addition: seedPolicies(policies[]) -> { inserted }, version 1.1.0). The registry file org/contracts/registry.json is outside this team's paths: post a contract-change to the architecture hub asking for the 1.1.0 bump, and mention it in your result. Also cache snapshots in policy_snapshots. verifyCoverage(claimId) calls ctx.modules.claims.getClaim; in tests use a small local fake claims service, do not depend on the claims team's code. Implement the rule logic as a pure function (policy, claim loss facts) -> { status, reasons[], deductible, limits, applicableCoverages } so it is table-testable. Include 6+ synthetic policies in a fixtures file (fictional names only, no real carriers) exported for the platform seed script. Pitfalls: loss date comparison in tenant timezone, glass is a comprehensive sub-coverage, events must carry ids/codes only, handler must use consumed_events idempotency, never log PII. Tests: tests/unit/coverage/{verify,mock-pas,search,service,events}.test.mjs. Write only your paths; do not commit.

verdicts.reason: All 7 criteria met; 78/78 coverage tests pass via glob form (bare dir form fails on Node 22.22 for all suites, env issue); registry bump to 1.1.0 pending architecture hub

escapedDefects.summary: Plaintext PII in policy snapshot cache
